newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Livestock analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 358,000 to 360,000 head versus 364,000 a week ago and 362,000 a year ago.
Saturday hog slaughter was estimated from 30,000 to 42,000 head versus 25,000 a week ago and 201,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 126,000 to 130,000 head versus 123,000 a week ago and 135,000 a year ago.
Saturday's slaughter estimates ranged from 25,000 to 30,000 versus 27,000 a week ago and 28,000 a year ago.
